Welcome to the latest edition of our healthcare newsletter!
Keep reading for all the new healthcare related developments at Flywire, including the launch of our new LinkedIn series: Healthy Bites! The consumer revolution has been digitized With digital adoption at the highest levels ever seen, revenue cycles can no longer afford to miss out on the opportunity. Watch our panel of leading experts discuss how to meet the growing demand for consumerism through a better digital framework and deliver big wins to both your revenue cycle and your patients in our latest webinar with Becker's Hospital Review. Stories from patients. Learnings from providers. Eliminating risk from healthcare's payment experience Ensuring your organization is PCI compliant does not mean that you've eliminated risk from your payment environment. Learn the steps you can take to be risk-free in part 1 of our interview with Dan Arntz, Eckohs' President of US Operations. Read the article <[[https://www.flywire.com/resources/eliminating-risk-from-healthcares-payment-experience-an-interview-with-eckohs-president-of-us-operations-dan-arntz?utm_source=marketo&utm_medium=newsletter]]> How Covid-19 changed payment security Moving to a remote, digitally-focused workforce has created new challenges for employers. Learn some tips from Dan Arntz, President of US Operations at Eckoh, on how to re-think your strategy around secure payments in part 2 of our interview.
